review_evidence: AllSymbol.lean: defines allSymbolTM and languages allZeros and allOnes; proves their DTIME and P memberships.
Contains.lean: defines containsTM and languages containsZero and containsOne; simp membership lemmas; DTIME and P theorems.
LastBit.lean: defines lastBitTM and languages lastBitZero and lastBitOne; fold lemmas; DTIME and P theorems.
LengthDivBy.lean: defines lengthDivByTM k with a ZMod k counter and language lengthDivBy; DTIME and P theorems.
Trivial.lean: languages empty and univ with membership proofs in DTIME, P, NP, BPP, PSPACE, EXP, PP and NEXP.
FirstCell.lean: FirstCellPhase, decideFirstCellTM, languages singletonEmpty, firstBitOne, firstBitZero and nonempty; complement and union theorems; P memberships.
LengthParity.lean: evenLengthTM, languages evenLength and oddLength, complement theorem, DTIME and P theorems.
AnBn.lean (1143 lines): AnBnPhase, anbnTM, ScanInv and RejectInv invariants, anbnTM_reachesIn, Language.anbn = {0^n 1^n}, anbnTM_decidesInTime (n+3), anbn_in_DTIME, anbn_mem_P.

Balanced.lean (1041 lines): BalancedPhase with Fintype instance, balancedTM counter machine, BalancedScanInv, push/switch/pop step lemmas, Language.balanced (equal counts of 0 and 1), integer boolDiff lemmas, balancedTM_decidesInTime, balanced_in_DTIME, balanced_mem_P.

ZeroPrefix.lean (1067 lines): ZeroPrefixPhase, zeroPrefixTM, ScanInv and RejectInv, zeroPrefixTM_reachesIn (|x|+3), Language.zeroPrefix = {0^n 1^m : n >= m}, characterization lemmas, zeroPrefixTM_decidesInTime, zeroPrefix_in_DTIME, zeroPrefix_mem_P.

Palindromes.lean (1148 lines): PalindromePhase, palindromesTM (copy, rewind, compare), CopyInv/RewindInv/CompareInv/PalRejectInv, phase lemmas, palindromesTM_reachesIn (3|x|+4), Language.palindromes = {x | x = x.reverse}, isPalindrome_iff_reverse_eq, palindromesTM_decidesInTime, palindromes_in_DTIME, palindromes_mem_P.
summary: Read all 11 of 11 listed Lean files completely (Complexitylib/Languages/*.lean). Each file defines one or more concrete Turing machines (TM 1) and languages over List Bool and proves correctness, running-time bounds (DecidesInTime), DTIME membership and P membership, several with long invariant-based proofs. Every file carries unique formal definitions, statements and proofs, so no file meets the FILTER-002/FILTER-004 content-level bar for exclusion. Disposition: retain all 11; rules is empty.
